title: Wɔn a Wɔhwɛ Kokoam Otwa So
intro: Wɔ asase bi a ɛso yɛ frɔmfrɔm so no, ankorankoro kuw bi yɛɛ kokoam nhyehyɛe bi wɔ esum akataso ase. Ná wɔn atirimpɔw koro, nanso na wɔn adwene nyɛ trenee koraa. Ná wonnim sɛ ɔsoro twitwiw bi retwɛn wɔn bere a wɔada no.
clues: Yɛsii gyinae pintinn, a na yesusuw sɛ yɛn nhyehyɛe no nni mfomso.
Yɛyɛɛ yɛn adwene sɛ yebefi adi ntɛm, ansa na afoforo atumi akanyan wɔn ho mpo.
Yɛde yɛn ho sii asase a ɛsow aba so, a na yɛwɔ ahotoso wɔ yɛn nnuan mu.
Bere a yeduu baabi a yɛrekɔ no, yehui sɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kwae na amamfõ, enti yesusuwii sɛ yɛayera kwan.
Afei yehui sɛ ɛyɛ yɛn beae ampa, na yɛde abasamtu teɛɛm, de yɛn ho yɛn ho asodi too yɛn ho so wɔ yɛn adehwere no ho.
Na yɛaka ntam saa anɔpa no sɛ yɛbɛyi ahiafoɔ afiri yɛn nnɔbaeɛ mu, nanso Allah asotwe baa yɛn so berɛ a yɛdaeɛ, na ɛdanee yɛn turo no sɛe.

identity.label: Yɛn Yɛ Henanom?
options: Turo no wuranom wɔ Surah 68 mu
Nnipa a Wɔte Saba
Ɔbodan no mu Ahokafo
Nnipa a Wɔyɛ Asono
Nnipa a Wɔte Amena no Mu
identity.answer: Turo no wuranom wɔ Surah 68 mu

trial.label: Yɛn Sɔhwɛ
options: Atoyerɛnkyɛm bi a efi soro sɛee yɛn turo no
Nsuyiri bi faa yɛn turo no mu
Ogya a efi ɔtamfo bi mu hyewee yɛn turo no
Ná mmoadabi ahyɛ yɛn turo no ma
Asasewosow bi menee yɛn turo no
trial.answer: Atoyerɛnkyɛm bi a efi soro sɛee yɛn turo no

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Yɛkaa ntam sɛ yɛbɛtetew n’aba anɔpa
Yɛyɛɛ abura bi de gugu yɛn turo no so nsu
Yɛhwehwɛɛ guankɔbea wɔ ɔbodan bi mu de hwehwɛɛ ahobammɔ
Yesiesiee asraafo dɔm sɛ wobedi ahenni bi so nkonim
Yɛde po so hyɛn twaa po no
location.answer: Yɛkaa ntam sɛ yɛbɛtetew n’aba anɔpa

outcome.label: Yɛn Nkrabea
options: Yenu yɛn ho na yɛhwɛɛ kwan sɛ mmɔborɔhunu bɛfiri Allah hɔ
Wɔsɛee yɛn koraa na yɛansakra yɛn adwene da
Yeguan fii asase no so na yɛansan amma bio
Yɛbɛyɛɛ tumifo ne adefo bio
Wɔtwee yɛn aso denam dan a wɔdan yɛn bonsu so
outcome.answer: Yenu yɛn ho na yɛhwɛɛ kwan sɛ mmɔborɔhunu bɛfiri Allah hɔ

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
